name: Settlement Fails Data 3
definition: Specifies the aggregated data of settlement fails instructions.

Total.name: Total
Total.definition: Total of all types of settlement transactions.

ParticipantInFail.name: Participant In Fail
ParticipantInFail.definition: Further details on the central securities depositories participants with the highest rates of settlement fails.

FailsPerCurrency.name: Fails Per Currency
FailsPerCurrency.definition: Further details on the settlement fails per currency.

FailsPerFinancialInstrumentType.name: Fails Per Financial Instrument Type
FailsPerFinancialInstrumentType.definition: Further details on the settlement fails per financial instrument type.

SecuritiesInFail.name: Securities In Fail
SecuritiesInFail.definition: Further details on the securities with the highest rates of settlement fails.

FailsPerTransactionType.name: Fails Per Transaction Type
FailsPerTransactionType.definition: Further details on the settlement fails per transaction type.

TotalSettlementPenalties.name: Total Settlement Penalties
TotalSettlementPenalties.definition: Total of all types of settlement penalties (such as total of late matching and settlement fails).

FailureReason.name: Failure Reason
FailureReason.definition: Further details on the reason for the settlement fails.
